metadata.title: Evaluate to true if the panos:config_test is properly supported.
metadata.description: This definition is intended to evaluate to true if the interpreter properly supports the panos:config_test for Palo Alto PAN-OS devices.

notes.note: It is important to note that the values used in this test definition are specific to a particular machine, and may not necessarily apply to your system. As a result, in order to have the definition return a result of 'true', you must either change these values to the ones found on your particular system, or you must configure your system to use these values.

criterion.comment: Test that the panos:config_test is supported

config_test.comment: Test that the config_object is supported.

config_object.comment: This object represents the PAN-OS hostname.

config_state.comment: Ensure the hostname matches what we expect to be in the test environment
